Not sure if you've seen that this needs to be updated if we unpin the theme version:
```
WARNING: `generate_nav_html` is deprecated and will be removed.Use `generate_toctree_html` instead.
```

Also, I think it's a better practice to not include the domain in internal links (in a link in a page hosted at pandas.pydata.org, use `/foo/bar.html` instead of `https://pandas.pydata.org/foo/bar.html`). If for whatever reason we host this under a different domain (a dev server, change of domain we use, a reverse proxy...), then having the domain make things way more difficult.

@phofl did you check if we're getting the dark theme out of the box with the new theme? If we do, feel free to add #42744 to the list of issues this closes in the description.

Btw, I think it'd be nice to get this in for the release. I added the 1.5 milestone for now. If you want me to continue the work on this and see what's wrong with the CI, just let me know.

issue_context.title: DOC: can't switch to the docs for a different version of pandas
issue_context.body:
### Pandas version checks

- [X] I have checked that the issue still exists on the latest versions of the docs on `main` [here](https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/dev/)


### Location of the documentation

Any page

### Documentation problem

When I try to see the docs for a different pandas version and chose any version in the top right version select widget I get redirected to https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/dev/undefined and get 404 error

Might have something to do with the error I see in the browser console:

![Screenshot from 2022-04-02 18-26-34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11873939/161387817-bdcf1560-f1b7-4d29-b46d-b380854a21ad.png)



### Suggested fix for documentation

Fix the version select widget  so it redirects to the documentation for the chosen version
comments:
https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/stable/ is now linked to https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/version/1.4.2/ since the release.

the version switcher still works for https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/version/1.4.1/ 

the version switcher does not work for the dev docs either. https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/dev/

so I assume that it is not directly related to the release, but maybe something that has been merged to master recently. Any changes to the web folders are uploaded to the web on merge to main and not tied to the release.

@dmitriyshashkin
can i work on this issue please ?
@samyberkane04 I don't think I'm the right person to ask this. I'm just a user, not the maintainer. But if for some unknown reason you need my opinion I certainly don't mind you fixing this issue :-)

This is caused by a change in the upstream theme, see https://github.com/pydata/pydata-sphinx-theme/pull/604. So short-term fix is pinning pydata-sphinx-theme to 0.8.0, and the longer term fix is to update our versions.json file to follow the required changes.
